note: DURING/AFTER capture for the 12-14 Nov 2026 western disturbance, taken 14 Nov 2026 19:57-20:02 PKT. IQAir city pages and every station linked from them, History > Hourly, US AQI+ (column series of the visible History chart). Per city: 'city' = IQAir's city figure (a median of stations); rows = [slug, 'Station from' attribution, header interval (latest reading, local time), first category, last category, hourly values, error]. Categories are hour starts in local time (PKT for Pakistan, IST for India). The last value is the hour starting at the last category on 14 Nov; the first is 46-47 hours earlier (12 Nov 20:00 PKT / 20:30 IST for most). A few series were read as the hour rolled over and run 21:00-19:00 (PKT) or 21:30-19:30 (IST). Empty = no reading. IQAir revises hours after first display. There is NO hourly capture between the BEFORE file (ends 11 Nov 00:00 PKT) and this one (starts 12 Nov 20:00 PKT).
method: User's Chrome: hidden same-origin iframes on each city and station URL; values read from options.series of the History .highcharts-container React props (visible copy), polled until two consecutive reads agreed; dumped to the page as text and copied verbatim from the get_page_text result in the session transcript. sha256 of the in-page JSON of 'cities' = 92f78a439a65cca862989e2cf7ddd59ce94f6c257c69074e88fc0ca1db00d443, reproduced from the saved text (after restoring the no-break space that get_page_text turned into a plain space in the Indian pages' interval text). The trailing 'Loca' (cut-off 'Local time') was then trimmed from the interval text; nothing else was changed.
